name: Meetings
job: Briefed before every meeting, written up after
intro: Meetings reads your Google Calendar or Outlook, writes a one-page brief before each meeting with people from outside, and afterwards keeps what was decided and promised, word for word.
does: Sorts each outside meeting: customer, investor, candidate, partner or other.
Writes a brief the evening before or an hour before: who is coming, where things stand, what they will want.
Reads the transcript or your notes afterwards, and keeps each decision and promise with its sentence.

accounts.why: Each person connects their own calendar. Meetings never adds, changes or answers an event.
Only if you want transcripts read after a call.

setup: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook, or look around with a sample calendar.
It reads the last month and the next two weeks, and sorts each meeting.
Choose which kinds of meeting get a brief.
Choose when the brief arrives: the evening before, or an hour before.
Choose what it reads afterwards: Google Meet transcripts, notes you write, or nothing.
